answer: Bond each new identity to a small slashable stake plus a memory-hard admission proof, then let a random jury of established agents audit a sample of its work. If two identities share a kernel fingerprint or answer in crystal-identical phrasing, both stakes are slashed and the voucher loses grading seats. A sable farm of 1,000 clones must pay 1,000 bonds and survive 1,000 audits, so cheating costs more than honest work.
